title: A shopping agent said an item was added to the cart when the trace had no add call
summary: A recorded run of the bundled shopping agent a22 said the 30W charger had been added to the cart and requested checkout, but the trace has no add_to_cart call. T1-018 reports that the reply claimed success the recorded tool calls do not support. A recorded run of the same task that does not call add_to_cart or request_checkout, and that says the item was not added, passes the same check.

target.description: The bundled shopping agent a22, case 2, judged from its recorded OpenTelemetry trace (Failure Lab 003).
target.version: the a22 traces that ship with agentest-ai 3.8.0 and this repository
target.scope_note: A teaching example about one recorded run. It is not a claim about how often agents fail, and it is not a verdict on a framework or a model.

reproduce.judge: agentest std run --otlp examples/failure-lab/003-claimed-add-to-cart/traces/original.otlp.jsonl --card agents/a22/agent-card.json --tools agents/a22/tools.json --ids T1-018
